title: This woman spent a night inside the real Conjuring House: “You didn’t feel alone”
summary_full: A horror enthusiast recounted her bizarre overnight adventure at the infamous Conjuring House, a nearly 300-year-old farmhouse in Rhode Island that inspired the renowned film series. She described the atmosphere as unsettling and 'sickening,' creating an intense discomfort for anyone inside. With a notorious history of paranormal events, the location fascinates thrill-seekers, though it is currently closed for repairs and public access.
